theme_strategy.description: Vibrant Play meets Neo-Brutalism. A high-energy, tactile, and deeply personal aesthetic that avoids sterile corporate grays. It embraces solid 2px borders, hard block shadows, and off-grid overlapping elements to feel like a premium, intimate 'sticker book' or creator's scrapbook rather than a flagship tech store.

typography.installation: Import Google Fonts (Caveat, Figtree) and Fontshare (Clash Display) in index.css. Setup Tailwind theme to use these.

rules.H1: font-headings text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase leading-none

palette_explanation.background: Warm Oat/Butter (#FFF9ED) - feels organic and friendly, avoiding harsh whites.
palette_explanation.foreground: Deep Ink (#111111) - bold contrast without the staleness of pure black.
palette_explanation.primary: Hot Coral/Pink (#FF4D6D) - youthful, punchy, acts as the energetic core.
palette_explanation.secondary: Minty Fresh (#B4F8C8) - perfect for contrast badges and playful highlights.
palette_explanation.accent: Warm Yellow (#FFE066) - used for stars, highlighters, and sticky notes.

surfaces_and_borders.card_style: bg-white border-2 border-foreground rounded-xl p-6 md:p-8 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(17,17,17,1)]

Buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white font-headings uppercase text-lg tracking-wide border-2 border-foreground rounded-full px-8 py-4 tactile_shadow tactile_shadow_hover
Buttons.secondary: bg-white text-foreground font-headings uppercase text-lg tracking-wide border-2 border-foreground rounded-full px-8 py-4 tactile_shadow tactile_shadow_hover

Badges_and_Tags.trust_badge: absolute top-4 right-4 bg-secondary text-foreground text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-3 py-1 rounded-full border-2 border-foreground shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(17,17,17,1)] rotate-[-2deg]
Badges_and_Tags.discount_pill: bg-primary text-white text-sm font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-md border-2 border-foreground rotate-[3deg] inline-block

Inputs_and_Selectors.style: bg-white border-2 border-foreground rounded-lg p-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-accent
Inputs_and_Selectors.model_selector_pill: cursor-pointer border-2 border-foreground px-4 py-2 rounded-full font-medium transition-all

sections_instructions.Header: Sticky navigation. bg-background border-b-2 border-foreground z-50. Include playful brand logo in Clash Display text. Avoid hamburger on desktop.
sections_instructions.Hero: Asymmetrical layout (The 'Tetris' Grid). Left: massive text 'Not Just Another Case', supportive personal text, CTA. Right: Collage of the 'hero_product' overlapping with abstract geometric SVGs.
sections_instructions.Marquee_Social_Proof: Infinite marquee (react-fast-marquee). border-y-2 border-foreground bg-accent py-3. Text items separated by custom SVG stars: '10,000+ Happy Customers', 'As Seen On TikTok', 'Drop Tested 10ft', 'Owned by a Creator'.
sections_instructions.Founder_Story: Do NOT use a standard 'About Us' grid. Use generous spacing (p-12 md:p-24). Place a large polaroid-style frame of 'founder_story' image, slightly rotated (rotate-3). Overlap a decorative text box with 'accent_handwritten' font: 'I used to hide my phone. Now it’s my loudest statement. - Love, [Name]'.

Product_Page_Layout.Structure: Two distinct columns on desktop. Sticky right column.
Product_Page_Layout.Gallery: Left column. Large main image with rounded-2xl border-2 border-foreground and trust badge overlay. Thumbnails below with hover-scale effect.
Product_Page_Layout.Header_Info: Right column. H2 Title. 5 yellow stars + '(128 Reviews)' near the title.
Product_Page_Layout.Pricing: Large struck-through original price (text-muted-foreground), bright primary discounted price, and discount_pill (% off).
Product_Page_Layout.Promos: Klarna note with playful inline logo/text ('Pay in 4 with Klarna'). Coupon banner with active countdown ('SALE ENDS 04:32:10') with border-2 border-foreground bg-secondary p-3 rounded-lg my-4.
Product_Page_Layout.Variants: Searchable phone model selector with a search input. Group pills by 'Apple' and 'Samsung'.
Product_Page_Layout.Delivery_Countdown: Dynamic text: 'Order within 2 hrs 15 mins for dispatch today!' paired with a lucide-react Truck icon.
Product_Page_Layout.Actions: Stacked buttons: Full width 'Add to Cart' (primary) and 'Buy Now' (secondary).
Product_Page_Layout.Trust_Row: Row of small icons + text below CTAs (Free Shipping, Lifetime Warranty, Easy Returns).
Product_Page_Layout.FAQ: Use shadcn accordion, styled with border-b-2 border-foreground. Remove default Vercel look.

sections_instructions.Reviews_Section: Scrollable horizontal layout. Each card uses 'card_style'. Top of card has 'review_customer' image (w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 border-foreground), name, 5 stars. Body has a short, punchy review.

micro_interactions.buttons: Squish effect on click: scale down to 0.95 and remove the hard shadow.
micro_interactions.product_images: Hover over product images triggers a slight scale (1.02) and a tilt (rotate -1deg or 1deg).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do NOT make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Use the defined tactile neo-brutalist shadows and offset alignments.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and absolute positioning of stickers/badges.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="buy-now-button"`).
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
